description: District Secretatiat of Galle - Notified that the Annual Lenten Season in Calvary Shrine, w.e.f. 06.03.2019 to 22.04.2019
categorisation: This gazette notification announces the schedule for an annual religious event (Lenten season at Calvary Shrine) under the Pilgrimages Ordinance. It does not involve government structure/personnel (Types 1-3) and does not fit any specialized categories (land, legal, commercial, elections, public service, or judicial). The content concerns cultural/religious administrative matters, making it Miscellaneous (Type 10).
